diagnostics.message: GPIO 36 has a hardware errata: interrupts may fire spuriously during WiFi/BT light sleep. Use a different pin for interrupt-driven input.
diagnostics.hint: GPIO 34, 35 do not have this errata.

diagnostics.message: `wifi.connect` has no fallback if it fails.
diagnostics.hint: Without one the program carries on offline. Add `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.
